## Current best

The best recorded overlap is **54/62**, from the pooled bitwise-majority candidate generated from two independent 50-shot Helios-1 native-`ZZPhase` batches. The earlier 500-shot P6 campaign remains a separate, diffuse hardware dataset.

The chi=32 emulator candidates are retained for comparison only. They came from an approximate, noiseless MPS simulation and are not hardware evidence.
